artworks.title: Oberlin College Graduates
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a collage of twelve individual portrait photographs. The portraits show the upper body or head and shoulders of the subjects, positioned in three rows of four portraits each. The individuals are directly facing the camera and have neutral expressions. They wear formal clothing typical of a past era, with the men in suit jackets and white shirts, and the women in dresses with visible collars. The subjects have neatly styled hair, ranging from combed-back styles for the men to parted and tied-up hair for the women. There are no visible jewelry or objects among the subjects. The background of each portrait is a neutral, dark shade. The collage is presented within an ornate, gilt-edged frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This grayscale photograph features a seated man, shown from the knees up. His body is slightly turned to the right, but he looks out at us, one arm resting on his lap and the other propped against a small round table on the right. The man has dark skin, faint eyebrows, high cheekbones, a faint mustache, lips set in a neutral expression, and short, dark hair under a tall white top hat with a thick gray band around the center. He is dressed in a formal black suit with a white, high-collared shirt, a black bow tie, and a dark jacket with a velvet collar. He appears to have a ring on one finger. The background behind him is light gray. The photograph is bordered by an ornate golden frame.

artworks.title: Millie Craig and Frederick H. Healey
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing side by side. On the left is an older woman with a headwrap, holding a piece of fabric. Next to her is a young child in a dark hooded garment. They are framed with intricate decorations and a gold border, against a dark background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman and Child
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman and a baby. The woman is sitting, holding the baby on her lap. She has dark skin and her facial features appear calm and composed. She is wearing a dark dress with a white lace collar and a plaid-patterned skirt. The baby has light-colored hair and face, and is wearing a light-colored dress with lace detailing. Both individuals are framed against a plain background. The photograph is encased in an ornate gold frame with intricate designs along the edges.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl and Postmortem Child
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, one adult and one young child. The adult is sitting with one shoulder slightly raised, their face partially obscured by darkness. They have short, dark hair and wear a top with a hinted-at pattern. The child is lying down with their eyes closed, visible from head to knees. The child has light hair and wears a pale garment. They lie on a patterned surface surrounded by fabric or a blanket, with flowers near their head. The image is in an ornate, gold-colored frame with floral engravings.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy Holding a Clay Pipe
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This image shows a young boy from the waist up, seated with a straight posture on a chair. He has a neutral expression and short, curly hair. He is wearing a dark-colored jacket over a light-colored shirt and an apron. The boy rests one arm on the chair's armrest, adorned with decorative upholstery, while the other hand holds a small object in his lap. The background is a plain, neutral-toned backdrop. The image is framed with an ornate design and set within a rectangular dark frame with a red border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Cat
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This grayscale photograph shows a cat resting on the woven seat of a wooden chair. The cat has a tuxedo pattern with darker fur on its back and legs and lighter fur on its face and paws. Its pointed ears are upright, and it looks toward us, its face slightly blurred. The chair has a simple design with a decorative back. The background is plain and light-colored. The oval photograph is framed in an ornate rectangular golden frame carved with floral motifs.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting with his right arm on a stack of three books on a patterned surface. His left hand is on his lap. The man has neatly-combed dark hair, smooth facial features, a high forehead, and light-colored eyes. He is dressed in a dark suit jacket, high-buttoned vest, white shirt with a high collar, and a dark bow tie. There is a watch chain on his vest. The background is plain. The image is framed in an ornate, gilded frame with a velvet lining.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation

artworks.title: The Hercules Family
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and three children, captured from the knees up. The woman is seated in the center, with one child standing on each side and another standing slightly behind her. The woman has dark, neatly parted hair, styled in smooth waves over her ears, with a composed expression. She wears a striped dress with lace details and a shawl-like garment on her shoulders. The two children on her left and right wear matching light pink dresses, have neatly combed hair, and wear dark, lacy gloves. The older boy behind the woman wears a suit with a white shirt and bow tie. The background is plain, and the portrait is in an ornate frame with intricate designs and a golden inner border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman, capturing her from the shoulders up. She is positioned directly facing the camera with a slight tilt of her head. The woman has smooth, dark hair styled in a middle part, with her hair sleekly wrapped over her ears. Her facial features include dark eyes and full lips. She is wearing an off-shoulder garment, possibly a dress or blouse, embellished with a delicate trim. The woman is also adorned with earrings. The photograph is enclosed in an ornate gold-tone frame with intricate floral and scrollwork details on the outer edge. The background within the frame appears neutral and unadorned.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a vintage portrait of a family consisting of six individuals, all visible from the knees up, sitting and standing closely together. At the center, a man and a woman are seated; the woman holds a young child on her lap. The man has short, neatly combed hair, a prominent forehead, and wears a solemn expression. He is dressed in a formal dark suit with a patterned waistcoat, light cravat, and a high collar shirt underneath. The woman beside him has her hair styled in smooth waves, parted in the center, and wears a serious expression similar to the man. Her attire is a dark dress with a buttoned front and lace detail around the collar. The young child has short hair and is wearing a dress, being supported by the woman. Flanking the seated adults are two girls, standing on either side. Both girls have shoulder-length hair styled in ringlets, wearing long dark dresses similar in style—high neck and long sleeves. Another girl stands on the far left, leaning slightly towards the man, appearing younger than the other two girls, sharing a similar hairstyle. The background of the image is plain, emphasizing the group's presence. The portrait is framed with an ornate, gold-edged mat that complements the subdued tones of the daguerreotype image.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Women
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: Two women are depicted in the image, sitting side by side. Both women are shown from the waist up, facing slightly towards the camera. The woman on the left has dark, long hair tied with a headscarf, and wears a dark, textured shawl over a long-sleeve garment. She is holding a fur wrap on her lap. The woman on the right has light-colored hair with a hat partially covering it, is dressed in a light checkered shawl and a dark dress or top with buttons, and holds a scarf or piece of clothing in her hand. The image is enclosed in an ornate gold frame, with a plain and neutral background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a woman's body. She is positioned slightly angled with her hands clasped in her lap. Her facial expression is neutral, with dark eyes and her hair parted down the middle and pulled back smoothly. She is wearing a dark dress with long sleeves and a white lace or ruffled collar. On her wrists, she wears bracelets, and rings adorn her fingers. The image is housed within a gold-colored, decorative frame featuring an inscription, and the background appears to be a solid, dark color that emphasizes her figure.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a young girl standing upright. She has dark, straight hair with a middle part, falling on her shoulders. She wears a light pink off-the-shoulder dress with multiple tiers and visible underskirt. She accessorizes with a gold-colored necklace, earrings, bracelets, and holds a decorative fan in her hands. Next to her is an ornate chair and a table with a patterned cloth. The background is plain and dark, and the image is framed with intricate gilded details.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in a semi-upright position. The individual has a serene expression with slightly arched eyebrows and a direct gaze. Her hair is styled away from her face, possibly held back by a decorative headpiece embellished with feathers and fabric ribbons. She wears a dark cape with a light-colored lace collar and a pink ribbon fastened at the neck by a circular brooch. Her dress, beneath the cape, features light-colored fabric with pleats. The person is shown holding a folded parasol and clutching a small bouquet of flowers in her left hand, while her right hand rests nearby, adorned with a beaded bracelet and a ring on her finger. The backdrop of the photograph is neutral. The image is framed with a richly ornate gold-toned border.

artworks.title: Martha Ann "Patty" Atavis and Anna Whitridge
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up, seated side by side. The man on the left has dark skin, is wearing glasses, and has short groomed hair. He is wearing a dark jacket, white shirt, and a bow tie with patterned trousers. The man on the right has lighter skin with wavy, medium-length dark hair. He is dressed in a dark jacket, white shirt, and a bow tie. Both men are positioned close, with the man on the left placing his hand on the right man's forearm. The image is in an ornate gold-colored frame against a dark background.

artworks.title: Dr. John Whitridge
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man captured from the waist up. He is positioned to slightly face towards his right. The man has a solemn expression with sharp facial features, including deep-set eyes and a straight nose. His hair is dark and combed back, showing signs of slight dishevelment at the top. He is wearing a formal suit, comprising a dark coat, and a white shirt with a high stiff collar accompanied by a dark cravat tied around his neck. The portrait is presented in an ornate frame with elaborate designs adorning the border. The background is plain and dark, highlighting the subject's features against it.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a historical portrait of a man from the waist up. The man is seated and facing forward with his body slightly turned. He has sharp facial features, including bushy eyebrows and a prominent chin, with side-parted dark hair that is short and neatly styled. He wears a formal, dark suit consisting of a jacket, waistcoat, and a white shirt with a bow tie. His right hand rests near his waist, while his left arm is relaxed by his side. The image is surrounded by a decorative gold frame with an ornate pattern and the photograph's surface shows tarnishing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body, from the waist up. The man is seated and facing forward, with his right arm resting on a surface and his left hand visible at his lapel. He has strong facial features with pronounced cheekbones and a stern expression. He has neatly styled hair, parted slightly to the side. The man is wearing formal attire, including a dark jacket, waistcoat, white shirt, and a wide, dark bow tie. The background is plain and neutral. The photograph is enclosed in an ornate, rectangular frame with intricate gold detailing along the edges.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman from the waist up, facing the camera directly. She has high cheekbones, dark skin, and a thoughtful expression. She wears a headscarf and a formal striped gown with ruffled detailing. The image is enclosed in a vintage gold frame with floral patterns. The background is a neutral-toned surface.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Girls
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two young girls sitting next to each other, facing the camera. The girl on the left has short, dark hair and the girl on the right has short, combed back hair. Both girls are wearing patterned dresses and have neutral expressions. The background is a plain backdrop and the photograph is framed by an ornate gold frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman seated and facing the camera, with her upper body visible from the waist up. She is positioned upright with her hands resting in her lap. Her facial features include wide-set eyes and slightly parted lips. She has dark hair secured back, possibly braided, and is wearing a high-collared dress with puffy long sleeves and a fabric that appears to have a subtle plaid or checkered pattern. A white collar with a brooch is visible around her neck. The photo is encased in an ornate golden frame with intricate designs. The background appears to be neutral.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image contains a three-quarter portrait of a man seated with one leg crossed over the other. He has short hair, facial features include a defined jawline and a serious expression. He is wearing a dark jacket, a high-collared white shirt, dark bow tie, and light-colored trousers. One hand rests on a patterned fabric surface, the other hand is on his lap. There is a ring on his right hand, and detailed buttons on his shirt. The background is plain, and the image is framed with an ornate, gold-colored frame with intricate designs.
